findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. The Windows suite fails after this quoting change. `repo.quote` now always wraps Windows paths in double quotes, so the changed `forge next` line prints `git worktree remove "..."`. The unchanged `test_merge_command.py:239` removes only single quotes before comparing the printed path with the worktree path. Its `test_5_merge_cleans_up_and_preserves_local_work[dirty]` case therefore fails on Windows, leaving the requested Windows test run red.
